summary: EZGO Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a 1-for-150 reverse share split approved by its board on May 6, 2026, effective May 19, 2026. The split reduces outstanding shares from ~345.9M to ~2.3M to meet Nasdaq continued listing requirements. No shareholder vote was required under BVI law. Fractional shares are rounded; no fractional shares issued. VStock Transfer acts as exchange agent. This is a routine corporate action to maintain listing compliance, not a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K regarding a reverse stock split.
